proofs.text: Tag PROOF-2 `@env` with an operating system that is not this one and run `--all --quick`; verify the output holds `Proofs another operating system owns:` and `feat PROOF-2: needs <os>`, that `produced no proof entry` is absent even when the test for it is skipped, and that the run exits 0. Tag PROOF-1 with this operating system; verify `needs` is absent and the proof file is written

rule_text: A proof the spec tags `@env` for another operating system is listed as needing that system, is not run here, and is never reported missing; a proof tagged for this one runs like any other

tests.body:
def test_a_foreign_env_proof_is_listed_as_needing_its_os(self, tmp_path):
        other = self._other_os()
        root = _pytest_project(tmp_path)
        _spec(root, 'feat', proofs=(('PROOF-1', 'RULE-1', ''),
                                    ('PROOF-2', 'RULE-1', ' @env(%s)' % other)))
        code, output = _run(root, '--all', '--quick')
        assert 'Proofs another operating system owns:' in output
        assert 'feat PROOF-2: needs %s' % other in output
        assert code == 0, output
tests.name: test_a_foreign_env_proof_is_listed_as_needing_its_os
